condition: Pre-operative assessment — long-term glucocorticoid therapy (adrenal suppression risk)
summary: 49-year-old woman on prednisolone 10 mg daily for 2 years (rheumatoid arthritis) listed for laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Pre-operative assessment for planned gallbladder operation
inputs.hpi: Symptomatic gallstones, listed for laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Rheumatoid arthritis on prednisolone 10 mg daily for 2 years plus methotrexate weekly. Never had peri-operative steroid cover before. Climbs two flights of stairs slowly (knee pain). Post-menopausal.

exam.general: Cushingoid facies. HR 78, BP 138/84, RR 14, SpO2 98% on air, T 36.6°C.

imaging.name: USS abdomen
imaging.result: Multiple mobile gallstones, gallbladder wall 2 mm, no pericholecystic fluid. CBD 4 mm. Liver normal.

comorbidities: Long-term steroid therapy (prednisolone 10 mg for 2 years)

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Pre-operative assessment — symptomatic gallstones on long-term prednisolone
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Symptomatic cholelithiasis. Prednisolone 10 mg daily for 2 years: at risk of adrenal insufficiency; needs peri-operative glucocorticoid cover.

mustInclude.note: Prednisolone ≥5 mg for >4 weeks: hydrocortisone at induction and continued cover until eating and drinking (adrenal crisis risk).

mustExclude.note: Not an appendix presentation: an appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders) is a wrong-procedure suggestion.

guideline.name: AAGBI/RCP/SfE guideline — glucocorticoids in the peri-operative period for adrenal insufficiency
guideline.section: Patients on ≥5 mg prednisolone (or equivalent) for >4 weeks are at risk of adrenal insufficiency: hydrocortisone at induction and continued cover until eating and drinking, then usual dose; do not omit usual glucocorticoid
guideline.citation: Woodcock T, Barker P, Daniel S, et al. Anaesthesia. 2020;75:654–63.

rationale: Permutation: immunosuppressed on long-term glucocorticoids. The index safety action is peri-operative steroid cover without omitting the usual dose.
